signals.text: 3 open PM roles across 2 US offices

roles.title: Senior Product Manager – AI Ready Data (SeekrFlow)

bullets: Define and own the product strategy and roadmap for AI Ready Data capabilities across SeekrFlow
Develop a deep understanding of how enterprise data is utilized across AI workflows, including retrieval, fine-tuning, evaluation, and agent-based systems
Define product capabilities across UI, API, and SDK surfaces, ensuring consistency across SaaS and self-hosted deployments
Partner closely with engineering, design, and research teams to identify opportunities for new platform capabilities
Evaluate emerging techniques, experiments, and research investments and determine their applicability to customer problems
